rows: What does M-state mean in MESI?
Modified: only this cache has it, it's dirty (written), memory is stale
Two cores writing different variables on the same cache line, causing spurious coherence traffic
Total Store Order — x86's memory model; stores go through a per-core buffer before becoming globally visible
What does ARM use instead of TSO?
Weak Memory Ordering — requires explicit DMB/LDAR/STLR for synchronization
What is the cost of a cache-to-cache transfer?
~30–60 cycles (vs ~4 for L1 hit, ~100 for DRAM)
How do you fix false sharing in C#?
Pad structures to 64 bytes, or use thread-local storage
